[7:44AM]  #LagIbdExpWay
#3MB
#TrafficUpdate

It's an encouraging traffic flow coming inward Berger from Kara bridge down to Tollgate.
Moving ahead to Estate en route Ogudu is also fair.
Traffic moves slowly approaching Ogudu bus stop down to the rehabilitation part on Ifako bridge.

Traffic is very rapid beyond Ifako bridge all the way to Iyana Oworo.

Inward the Third mainland bridge is also good upto Adekunle Merging point, then moves steadily en route Adeniji.

The return journey from Adeniji back to Iyana Oworo down to Berger is good.
#FollowLASTMA
